title: “I think there’s a lot of value in these.” – Unsung
excerpt: A blog about software craft and quality
content_html:
Speaking of user interface guidelines, developer Matt Sephton and others compiled many of Apple’s human interface guidelines, starting from 1980, all the way to 2014, including some goodies like early drafts, NeXT, Newton, and so on.

Elsewhere, designer Geof Crowl put together his own list that goes broad instead of deep, including style guides other than Apple’s, too.

The list was made in 2020 and a few links are already broken, but there are some gems here like the modern Designing for Playdate, or the classic Zen of Palm from 2003. You can learn a lot just by grabbing one and scanning it.

Let me add a few more I know of:

  • Amiga User Interface Style Guide (1991)
  • Magic Cap Concepts (1995) with a strange subtitle “Everything right is wrong again”
  • Java Look and Feel Design Guidelines (1999)
  • Windows Interface Guidelines for Software Design (1995)

content_html_zh:
说到用户界面指南，开发者 Matt Sephton 等人整理了许多 Apple 的人机界面指南，从 1980 年开始一直到 2014 年，其中包括一些早期草案、NeXT、Newton 等好东西。

在其他地方，设计师杰夫·克劳尔 (Geof Crowl) 整理了自己的清单，内容广泛而不深入，还包括苹果以外的风格指南。

该列表是 2020 年制定的，一些链接已经失效，但这里有一些精华，例如现代的 Playdate 设计，或 2003 年的经典 Zen of Palm。 只需拿起一个并扫描它，您就可以学到很多东西。

我再补充几个我知道的：

  • Amiga 用户界面风格指南 (1991)
  • 《Magic Cap Concepts》（1995）有一个奇怪的副标题“一切对的又错了”
  • Java 外观设计指南 (1999)
  • Windows 界面软件设计指南 (1995)
